notes: Homonym: shares consonants יגה with H3013 ("be grieved"), a separate, unrelated Strong's entry already in this dataset (Strong's own etymology note even calls the two "probably rather the same as 3013, through the common idea of dissatisfaction" -- a shared etymological origin, not the same attested word; the corpus tags this occurrence to 3014 specifically, a distinct causative sense "push away/remove" vs. H3013's stative "grieve"). Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), H3013 has been retroactively relabeled יגה¹ in this same batch and this root is יגה².
